name: jay
description: Plugins for working with Claude Code and opencode across sessions: a task and note store, session coordination, status reports, coding and PR workflows

plugins.name: fyi
plugins.description: Durable store for tasks, notes, projects and tracked pull requests, kept as Markdown under ~/.fyi

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Start sessions as roles, and coordinate them: who is working on what, jobs routed by capability, messages, and a dashboard

plugins.name: status
plugins.description: A brief status for teammates and a weekly report, built from your GitHub activity and fyi

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Write code with Claude: a coder role, one command for work of any size with as much tracking as it needs, and code-quality rules with stable IDs

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: Pull requests with Claude: a watcher that follows GitHub for you, a reviewer, and a queue of what needs you
